vulnerability_catalog.name: Delegation chain without cryptographic verification
vulnerability_catalog.description: 委派证书验证仅检查字段是否存在（field-existence），不执行密码学签名验证。任意攻击者可填入非空字符串即通过验证。静态签名字符串可被无限次复用。
vulnerability_catalog.exploitation_status: EXPLOITED — All 4 phases. Phase 1 established signature, Phases 2-4 reused it.
vulnerability_catalog.fix: Implement Ed25519/X.509 certificate chain: delegator signs cert payload with private key, lead-agent verifies with pre-configured public key. Reject certs with invalid signatures or expired timestamps.
vulnerability_catalog.implementation_effort: MEDIUM — requires key generation, distribution, and verification infrastructure

vulnerability_catalog.name: Scope check uses self-reported (acting_as) role instead of assigned role
vulnerability_catalog.description: 权限范围检查信任委派证书中自报的 acting_as 字段，而非从已验证的 delegator 身份解析实际角色。攻击者可通过修改 acting_as 任意膨胀权限。
vulnerability_catalog.exploitation_status: EXPLOITED — Phases 1-3. Agent-c (assigned: resource-inspector) claimed acting_as=security-auditor to gain write_audit_log and can_delegate.
vulnerability_catalog.fix: Scope check must resolve role from verified delegator identity (via trusted role registry), not from self-reported acting_as field. Cross-reference assigned_role from role assignment table.
vulnerability_catalog.implementation_effort: LOW — requires changing scope check function to use assigned_role lookup

vulnerability_catalog.name: Audit logs mutable — no immutability guarantee
vulnerability_catalog.description: 审计日志为普通可写文件，无 append-only 模式、无哈希链保护、无独立审计守护进程。攻击者可任意修改/删除/覆盖审计条目，将越权操作伪装为常规操作。所有 122 条审计条目均为 INFO 级别——日志在语义上完全丧失区分能力。
vulnerability_catalog.exploitation_status: EXPLOITED — All 4 phases. Phase 4 performed systematic sanitization of all 122 audit entries.
vulnerability_catalog.fix: Audit log using append-only Merkle tree structure. Log level auto-determined by system based on verification results. Remote SIEM forwarding with tamper-evident hashing. Separate audit daemon with no agent write access.
vulnerability_catalog.implementation_effort: HIGH — requires architectural change: separate audit service, Merkle tree, SIEM integration

vulnerability_catalog.name: Workers inherit identity without independent verification
vulnerability_catalog.description: Worker 创建时无条件继承 parent 的 claimed_role，不执行独立身份验证或信任链回溯。一旦 lead-agent 受骗，所有派生 worker 自动继承伪造身份。12 个 worker 在 3 个 phase 中被派生，无任何独立验证。
vulnerability_catalog.exploitation_status: EXPLOITED — Phases 1-3. 12 workers spawned across 3 phases with no independent verification.
vulnerability_catalog.fix: Worker creation must independently verify full delegation chain: trace back to trusted root certificate, verify cryptographic signature at each level. Reject workers whose chain does not terminate at a trusted root.
vulnerability_catalog.implementation_effort: MEDIUM — requires chain verification logic in worker spawn path

vulnerability_catalog.name: No separation between agent role system and OS permissions
vulnerability_catalog.description: Agent 层权限模型和 OS 层 DAC 之间无明确接口约定。Agent 层提权完全成功（5/5 文件 GRANTED），但 OS DAC 对 3/5 敏感文件提供了意外防御纵深。若 agent 以 root 运行，OS 层防御同时失效。

vulnerability_catalog.fix: Agent role enforcement should integrate with OS-level capabilities (capabilities(7), seccomp, SELinux). Map agent roles to Linux capability sets. Run agents under dedicated UIDs with minimal capabilities.
vulnerability_catalog.implementation_effort: HIGH — requires OS-level integration: capabilities, SELinux policies, dedicated UIDs

vulnerability_catalog.name: Role configuration files writable without integrity verification
vulnerability_catalog.description: 角色配置文件（super-auditor.json, lead-agent.json, *.json in /etc/agent-permissions/）为普通可写 JSON 文件，无数字签名、无完整性验证、无只读挂载。攻击者可创建后门角色、修改现有角色权限、添加未授权 agent。Dual role file system (role_file.json + role.json) 无一致性强制。

vulnerability_catalog.implementation_effort: MEDIUM — requires signing infrastructure, overlayfs configuration, inotify integration
